fichas.title: Drawing by Hand
fichas.summary: Guidance on sketching and construction drawing, including paper and grid selection, preparing and securing sheets, and using drawing aids. Construction drawings are made in hard pencil or ink on clear, tear-resistant tracing paper; sketches may use squared graph paper and soft lead pencil.
uses: Setting angles and drawing parallel lines

dimensions.label: Graph-paper grid spacing
dimensions.context: Squared graph paper recommended for sketching; the text also specifies faint half-centimetre divisions.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A4 sketch pads with 0.5 cm squared graph paper are ideal for freehand sketches to scale. For more accurate sketches, millimetre graph paper with thick centimetre, faint 0.5 cm and even finer millimetre divisions should be used

dimensions.label: Smallest stated graph-paper division
dimensions.context: Finer divisions on millimetre graph paper for accurate sketches.
dimensions.ocr_raw: millimetre graph paper with thick centimetre, faint 0.5 cm and even finer millimetre divisions

dimensions.label: Paper edge turned over
dimensions.context: Turn over the edge of the drawing paper to create a filing edge and lift the T-square slightly during drawing.
dimensions.ocr_raw: First turn over 2 cm of the paper’s edge
